notes: Writers in lineage (20): 9 business CRM writers mapped here (52 attributes). Excluded: 6 ETL plumbing (Etl Warning x2, ETL Warning, Create ETL Warning x2, ETL Record Finish); 4 agent e-mail scripts (Handle Wait Status\Email - Start Date Poa, ...With Commission Appointment; Handle Active Status\Email - Cancel Poa To Perform Actions, ...With Commission Appointment) whose Input0_ProcessInput and Input0_ProcessInputRow bodies are fully commented out ('In Comment due to 13366', e.g. Email - Start Date Poa main.cs:46-73, 239-267) - CreateEmail/SendEmail are dead code, no CRM write; Send Poa Emails\Send Email (email create + SendEmail in PostExecute) excluded as e-mail sending per assignment.

EntityReference logical names (logic-analyst hypothesis). DTSX facts: (1) Both create scripts send gen_agentname = EntityReference("gen_agents", Gen_powerofattorneymain.Gen_agentname) and gen_agencyname = EntityReference("gen_agencie", Gen_powerofattorneymain.Gen_agencyname) (DTSX:1956/1960, 6396/6400). (2) In the SAME package the SQL treats gen_powerofattorney.gen_agentname as a contact id and gen_agencyname as an account id: 'join contact on gen_agentname = contactid' + 'join Gen_agents on Gen_agents.gen_contactname = gen_agentname' (Get Agent DTSX:31644-31645), 'join account on gen_agencyname = accountid' + 'join Gen_agencie on Gen_agencie.gen_agencyname = Gen_powerofattorney.gen_agencyname' (Get Agencie DTSX:31565-31566), 'left join Contact on Contact.ContactId=poa.Gen_agentname' / 'Account.AccountId=poa.Gen_agencyname' (DTSX:27226 source). So Gen_agents/Gen_agencie exist as CRM tables but are linked to the contact/account via their own gen_contactname/gen_agencyname columns, i.e. a gen_agents record id is NOT the contact id stored in gen_powerofattorney.gen_agentname. (3) Other supplied code (0029_POA, disabled flows) writes gen_powerofattorney.gen_agentname/gen_agencyname as EntityReference("contact"/"account") (0029 DTSX:10987-10988, 13906-13907) and gen_powerofattorneymain.gen_agentname as "contact" (0029 DTSX:22820/22823). (4) gen_customerprogram = EntityReference("gen_policies", Gen_programmain.Gen_programmainid) while this package joins gen_powerofattorney.gen_customerprogram to Gen_programmain.Gen_programmainId (DTSX:18206, 27226) and 'gen_policies' appears nowhere else in the DTSX (only DTSX:6392, 7979). Conclusion: the DTSX proves the logical names disagree with the entity the id comes from / the package's own joins; it does NOT prove the runtime outcome (CRM metadata not supplied). If CRM validates lookup targets, these attributes would make every such create (and the pension annotation move) fail into the Error output -> ETL warning. Status: hypothesis strengthened, still unverified.

Handle Wait Status\Update NeedToSendMailBit (Unsupported SQL on Gen_powerofattorneyBase): writes dateadd(HH,3, waiting POA gen_receivingdate) - an already +3h-shifted value - straight into the Base table; CASE without ELSE sets gen_receivingdateofcancelpoa to NULL on the old active POA when its own Gen_appendixtype is not 2/3/5. The target row is the active POA picked by a Full-cache Lookup (first match if several active POAs share the account/program).

Send Poa Emails\Update sentToPrintOn (Unsupported SQL on view Gen_powerofattorney, gen_SentToPrintOn = GETUTCDATE()) also runs for rows routed only to the error file (no agent e-mail) because both 'Check If Exists Agent_cy Email Address' branches are unioned before 'Update IsProcessed True' -> 'Update sentToPrintOn'.

Handle Wait / Active Status: the async Custom Output rows of the Set Data scripts never reach the CRM status writers (only 'No Data' of 'Is emailDetailsJson Contains Data 1' is connected and those rows carry non-NULL JSON); the CRM writers receive each source row once through the sync Output 0 / other branches. In Handle Active Status the Custom Output column genstatustransfertobank is never assigned (always NULL).

Move Annotation To Customer Account / To Policies run per row BEFORE 'Remove Duplicates'. The Annotation join sits inside the ROW_NUMBER subquery (rowNumber = 1 per account/program, DTSX:3323/3336, 7618/7630), so each row carries one annotation and other annotations of the POA Main never move. Only when several rows carry the SAME AnnotationId (several new accounts/programs of one POA Main) is the note re-pointed once per row, ending on the last processed row (order undetermined); the logic analyst's 'first created account' is not proven. In Pension the note can move to a program whose create is then dropped by Remove Duplicates (key Gen_powerofattorneymainId only). Create Power Of Attorney runs before the Pension flow (precedence DTSX:44839-44841), so an annotation already moved to a customer account is no longer found by the Pension source (join ObjectId = POA Main).

Create scripts: dates from CRM SQL (stored UTC) are shifted by a fixed AddHours(3) before Create (no DST logic); gen_startdate = DateTime.Now; gen_appendixd receives the appendix TYPE value; gen_statustransfertobank is always 2 when the POA Main value is valid. In the account create the advisor/consult block is skipped when gen_productsubcustomeraccount == 2 ('gemel to invest'); the pension create has no such condition. Unused inputs: Gen_customeridnumber (account), programmainIdentityNumber (pension), AnnotationId in creates.

Remove Duplicates in the Pension flow keys only on Gen_powerofattorneymainId (DTSX:9066-9068) -> at most one pension program per POA Main per run; others only on later runs while still within the 2-day CreatedOn window.
Mechanism note: SDK calls go through CRM.Proxy (CrmProxy / GetCrmService) - external assembly, not supplied; the DLLs of script components are not decompiled (C# source analysed).

Verifier finding (hypothesis per SSIS semantics): 'Is Renewal' and 'AppendixType' fail the component on expression error (NULL operands); because 'Sort By PoaId' is blocking, such a failure stops all activations in the run while NeedToSendMailBit SQL updates already done stay committed. See ACTIVE and NeedToSendMailBit conditions.
